w:r.w:t: Architecture: Decoupled (React Frontend + Core PHP REST API Backend)
All endpoints except login require authentication via HTTP header:
Description: Authenticate user and return token
Description: Get all system staff users
Description: Create a new system user account
Description: Activate or deactivate user (soft delete logic)
Description: Get or search patient records
Description: Register a new patient profile
Description: Book appointment and generate queue number
Description: Get doctor active queue for current date
Description: Save consultation and complete appointment
All database operations must use PDO prepared statements
Token authentication required for protected routes
All inputs must be validated on server side before processing
